interface: The existing --fit-profile command accepts an optional ink_atlas object with the RegistryInput fields path, size and SHA256. The user selected a pinned TXD file. Native metrics still come from the existing candidate ELF or ISO source.
sources: The candidate ELF and atlas are independently pinned inputs. Their measurements do not establish installed pairing or actual screen fit. The exact names font0, font1 and font2 select three 512x512 source atlas pages; their physical order is irrelevant.
geometry: For glyph word g, page=g/441 and local=g%441. Its 24x24 tile starts at (24*(local%21), 24*(local/21)). Scan every pixel with positive alpha: raw alpha 1 counts, while hidden RGB at alpha 0 does not. Translate the local bounds by the incoming pen minus the native left bearing. Rectangles are half-open and Y is local to each line. Nominal metric width does not replace measured alpha bounds.
advance: inspect retains the three raw metric bytes and computes max(22, left+ink+3)-left. The source-guarded exception uses ink+3. Unsigned native metrics therefore yield an advance of at least 3. The earlier (24,0,0) expectation of -2 was independently corrected before implementation: its advance is 3, and an explicitly mapped blank glyph has known empty ink. The existing controls guard for a missing or nonpositive supplied advance remains unchanged.
tokens: controls retains its existing admission rules for literals, SPACE, LINE, PAGE, headers, speakers and highlight framing. SPACE draws no atlas tile. LINE and PAGE preserve ordered segments, including trailing empty lines, and reset X. A bounded 0x7000 substitution keeps its prior conservative advance but makes ink unknown for the whole row, including later literal origins. Other unresolved, positioned or scaled controls keep their existing refusals. Wrapping policy is unchanged.
result: ink_status is measured, known_empty or unknown. Bounds appear only when the whole row is known. within_profile still describes advance, count and byte checks; it does not certify ink fit or physical screen fit. Without an atlas, complete legacy report bytes remain unchanged.
ownership: inspect reads raw bearings with the native advances. previewFit validates and decodes the atlas and derives glyph bounds once per report. controls accumulates bounds in its existing line and page walk. RegistryInput, readInput, indexTextures and texture are reused. No function, named type, helper or dependency was added.
source_guards: The optional atlas object rejects unknown, aliased, duplicate, null and missing required fields. Its profile-relative TXD path must identify a bounded regular file. Size and full hash are checked before measurement. The file is read again before output to check its hash, identity, size and modification time. Missing or duplicate page names and invalid dimensions, format or metadata produce a refusal without a report.

limitation: A file change during measurement was not dynamically tested. The runtime rechecks atlas contents and identity before output, and that guard was reviewed in source. Concrete input cases exercise 11 of the 12 named admission obligations. No timing-sensitive watcher framework was added.

It does not resolve consumer_layout.04 scale and FPU behavior or consumer_layout.06 physical and nested geometry. No family, script retirement or original renderer parity claim follows from this increment.
